collection.title: Ford Mondeo Estate 2000 to 2007 Windscreen Wiper Blades
collection.description: A Ford Mondeo Estate 2000 - 2007 model requires a 22" wiper blade for the drivers and a 20" passengers side with a Standard Hook Arm attachment, All of the following wiper blades are designed to fit this vehicle, with the option of upgrading to the Retrofit Flat type of windscreen wiper. The choice of rear screen wipers for this Mondeo which can be viewed by clicking on the Rear Screen Wiper Blade tab below.
